title: feat: add Microsoft-Decision-1 for typed decisions
author: tomdacatto

gist.summary: Added Microsoft-Decision-1 for paid-balance requests to /alpha/decisions and /v1/chat/completions. It returns calibrated probabilities for fixed choices rather than generated text; the chat endpoint accepts the decision JSON in the last user message. Pricing is based on input tokens per 1M tokens. Requests use Vercel AI Gateway, with a hidden OpenRouter route as fallback for gateway failures; both routes use the same Azure backend, so the fallback does not cover an Azure outage.
